description: Schema map from each Wattershed score metric back to the official registry and ingestion endpoint that produces it, with publication timestamp and native spatial resolution per index block.

conventions.published: When the PUBLISHER released the block. Granularity varies (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or 'rolling').
conventions.describes: The period the data describes — distinct from 'published' and from retrieval.
conventions.observed_retrieval: When THIS checkout actually fetched the file (from data/cache/*.meta.json).
conventions.spatial_unit: Native geometry a value resolves to. A point score is only as sharp as its coarsest input.

ingestion_mode.static_snapshot: Bulk file pinned at reference-build time.
ingestion_mode.periodic_bulk: Bulk file refreshed on a cadence.
ingestion_mode.api_live: Queried per screening run; retrieval stamped in the run ledger.
ingestion_mode.transcribed_constant: Constants hand-copied from a cited publication.

status.declared_not_ingested: Listed only to state plainly that it is NOT read by this tool.

blocks.role: Baseline water stress (withdrawals ÷ renewable supply) — structural scarcity
blocks.spatial_note: Native Aqueduct 4.0 sub-basin geometry; variable area, no raster cell size. U.S. clip committed as data/processed/aqueduct_bws_us.gpkg.

blocks.role: Current drought category at the point — the dynamic water signal
blocks.spatial_note: Generalized to roughly county / sub-county scale; not a gridded product.

blocks.role: 5-year county DSCI climatology — distinguishes chronic from episodic drought
County public-supply withdrawal denominator for modeled demand comparison
blocks.refresh_cadence: ~5-yearly compilation; 2015 remains the latest complete county census
blocks.caveat: Eleven years stale as of screening. Flagged LOW confidence for counties with material post-2015 demand change; it is a denominator, never a score input.

blocks.role: Subregion CO₂e output emission rate, fuel mix, and annual net generation
blocks.spatial_note: Annual average, location-based accounting — NOT marginal or hourly emissions. A subregion spans multiple states; the point inherits the whole subregion's rate.

blocks.role: Point-in-polygon assignment of a site to its eGRID subregion
Forward resource-adequacy risk category for the assessment area
blocks.spatial_note: Coarser than eGRID subregion; joined via a hand-maintained crosswalk (data/reference/egrid_subregion_map.csv). Imperfect mappings are documented.
blocks.caveat: Categorical risk designations are hand-transcribed from the published PDF and are checkable against it. Publication date and horizon come from provenance.NERC_LTRA_* so every surface cites one verified edition.

burden.label: Community burden
registries: Public Environmental Data Partners (original: U.S. EPA)

blocks.role: Tract adult-asthma and fair/poor self-rated health prevalence
blocks.spatial_note: Small-area MODELED estimates, not direct measurement — tract values are synthesized from BRFSS respondents plus tract covariates.

blocks.role: TRI / Superfund / RCRA facility coordinates → 5 km proximity and per-tract density
blocks.spatial_note: Point locations buffered to 5 km per EJScreen's proximity convention. This is the facility REGISTRY (FRS), not annual TRI release quantities.
blocks.refresh_cadence: continuous upstream; re-pulled at reference build

blocks.role: Live per-site TRI facility enrichment (names, programs) for nearby facilities
blocks.spatial_note: Enrichment only — displayed as context, carries no score weight.
blocks.caveat: TRI *release* tonnage logs are not ingested. Toxics burden enters the index through EJScreen's RSEI-modeled air-toxics field, not raw TRI reporting.

blocks.role: Tract low-income, unemployment, limited-English, education, race/ethnicity, population
blocks.spatial_note: 5-year pooled estimates carry margins of error that are not propagated into the index.

blocks.role: Nine frozen pollution-burden indicators (PM2.5, ozone, NO₂, diesel PM, air toxics, traffic, NPL/RMP/TSDF proximity)
blocks.spatial_note: Native geometry is block group; aggregated to tract population-weighted at reference build. Aggregation smooths within-tract variation.
blocks.refresh_cadence: FROZEN — EPA withdrew EJScreen in February 2025
blocks.caveat: Vintage cannot advance. Sourced from the Public Environmental Data Partners restoration of the final public release; alternates at Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/RLR5AX and Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.14767363.

cross_cutting.role: Address / coordinate → census tract and county assignment
Population-weighted tract centroids for the 5 km neighborhood summary
cross_cutting.spatial_note: Centroid membership, not areal intersection — a large tract counts wholly in or wholly out of the 5 km buffer.

context_layers.note: Refreshed automatically; feeds no pillar score by design.

blocks.role: Data-centre facility locations → per-tract clustering (Infrastructure Density Modifier)
blocks.describes: OSM database state at fetch time
blocks.spatial_note: Assigned to an exact census tract by FCC point-in-polygon, cached per facility so each cycle geocodes only newly discovered sites.
blocks.caveat: Crowd-sourced and not exhaustive. Descriptive context only — deliberately excluded from all three pillars, and from the siting-equity study, where feeding data-centre density into the burden pillar would be circular.

blocks.role: Announcement / permit / construction headlines for human review
blocks.caveat: UNVERIFIED secondary reporting, capped at 400 retained items. Never a measurement, never a score input; every record carries verified=false.

blocks.role: Operating generator capacity by balancing authority — supply-side context
blocks.refresh_cadence: bi-weekly poll of a monthly series
blocks.caveat: OPTIONAL and key-gated — the one registered source that is not keyless. Skipped cleanly when EIA_API_KEY is unset. Supply-side capacity only; the EIA-930 hourly feed remains uningested (see grid.eia_hourly_ba).

not_ingested.expected_registry: real-time gauge hydrology (USGS NWIS/Water Services) is not read by this tool
not_ingested.why_not: Declared explicitly to prevent a plausible misreading: the water pillar's dynamic component is USDM weekly drought, not USGS real-time streamflow. Instantaneous gauge discharge is a poor proxy for siting-horizon supply risk and no NWIS endpoint is called anywhere in the codebase.

not_ingested.expected_registry: EIA-930 hourly balancing-authority operations are not read by this tool
not_ingested.why_not: config.EIA_API_KEY exists as an unused optional hook; no EIA endpoint is called. The grid pillar is annual-average (eGRID) plus forward-looking categorical (NERC). Hourly BA data would enable marginal/time-matched emissions — a documented v2 roadmap item, not a current input. See docs/LIMITATIONS.md.

usdm_current.name: U.S. Drought Monitor — current weekly map
usdm_current.license: Public. Courtesy line: 'The U.S. Drought Monitor is jointly produced by the National Drought Mitigation Center at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln, the United States Department of Agriculture, and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.'

usdm_county_history.name: U.S. Drought Monitor — county drought-severity time series

aqueduct40.name: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 — baseline water stress (bws), annual, sub-basin
aqueduct40.license: CC BY 4.0 — attribution: 'Kuzma et al. (2023). Aqueduct 4.0, World Resources Institute.'

usgs_wateruse_2015.name: USGS Estimated Use of Water in the U.S. — county-level, 2015
usgs_wateruse_2015.notes: 2015 remains the latest full county water-use census; flagged LOW-confidence for change-sensitive counties.

egrid2023.name: EPA eGRID2023 (rev. 2, June 2025) — subregion emission rates, fuel mix, net generation

census_geocoder.name: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (address & coordinate → tract/county)

acs_2023_5yr.name: American Community Survey 2019–2023 5-year, tract tables (bulk summary file)

cdc_places_2024.name: CDC PLACES 2024 release — census-tract health outcomes
cdc_places_2024.notes: Measures: CASTHMA (adult asthma), GHLTH (fair/poor self-rated health).

frs_national.name: EPA Facility Registry Service — national geocoded facility file
frs_national.notes: Used for TRI / Superfund (SEMS) / RCRA facility proximity.

envirofacts_tri.name: EPA Envirofacts — TRI facility detail (live per-site enrichment)

ejscreen_v232_replica.name: EPA EJScreen 2.32 tract data (community-restored replica)
ejscreen_v232_replica.provider: Public Environmental Data Partners (original: U.S. EPA)
ejscreen_v232_replica.license: Public domain (U.S. federal work product, community-rehosted).
ejscreen_v232_replica.notes: EPA removed EJScreen from public access in February 2025. Five pollution-burden fields (PM2.5, ozone, diesel PM, air-toxics cancer risk, traffic proximity) are taken from the restored final release because their upstream models (AirToxScreen, FHWA AADT fusion) are impractical to rebuild live. Vintage is frozen and flagged.

nerc_ltra_2025.name: NERC 2025 Long-Term Reliability Assessment — resource-adequacy risk categories
nerc_ltra_2025.license: Publicly released assessment; categorical risk designations transcribed to data/reference/nerc_ltra.csv.

osm_datacenters.name: OpenStreetMap — data-centre facility tags (telecom=data_center)
osm_datacenters.notes: Crowd-sourced and NOT exhaustive: coverage varies by region and a campus is only present once a mapper adds it. Feeds the descriptive infrastructure-density layer only; never a pillar score.

google_news_rss.name: Google News RSS — data-centre announcement leads
google_news_rss.vintage: rolling — trailing weeks at each sync
google_news_rss.license: Headlines and links only; each item links to its publisher.
google_news_rss.notes: UNVERIFIED secondary reporting. Lead generation for human review — explicitly not a measurement and not an input to any score.

eia_v2_capacity.name: EIA v2 — operating generator capacity by balancing authority
eia_v2_capacity.license: Public domain (U.S. federal work). Requires a free API key.
eia_v2_capacity.notes: OPTIONAL and key-gated — the only registered source that is not keyless. Absent EIA_API_KEY the sync skips it and succeeds. Supply-side capacity context; NOT the EIA-930 hourly balancing-authority feed.
